# design-tokens

> Shared design tokens, CSS, icons, and HTML components for static sites and diagram tools

This repository defines token values, shared styles, and browser behavior. Consumer apps provide content and routes, then include the HTML and CSS from this package in their pages.

## Docs

- [아키텍처](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woonyong-choi/design-tokens/main/docs/architecture.md): 코드 구조, 생성 흐름과 소유 경계
- [공통 아이콘](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woonyong-choi/design-tokens/main/docs/design/content-icons.md): 아이콘 출처, 표현과 소비 계약
- [공통 구성 요소](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woonyong-choi/design-tokens/main/docs/components.md): HTML 입력, 조립과 브라우저 동작
- [공통 디자인 배포](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woonyong-choi/design-tokens/main/docs/distribution.md): Git 설치, 패키지 진입점과 갱신
- [스타일 구조](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woonyong-choi/design-tokens/main/docs/styles.md): CSS 소유, 토큰 참조와 검사 범위
